target_function: A general-purpose unity-gain analog voltage buffer for a sky130 mixed-signal PHY: isolate a high-impedance on-chip reference node from a switched-capacitor sampling load without degrading the reference's DC value.
application: Reference-buffer subsystem feeding a switched-capacitor stage (nominal 1 pF sampling load).

dc_open_loop_gain_db.rationale: buffer static gain error < ~3% needs open-loop gain comfortably above the 26 dB (20x) floor; 30 dB target.

unity_gain_bandwidth_hz.rationale: settle a 1 pF sampling load within a modest SC clock period.

system_power_budget_uw.note: whole reference-buffer subsystem (bias generation + OTA core), to be partitioned in S2.

constraints: sky130A open PDK only (CLAUDE.md: open PDKs only).
headless, JSON-contracted flow end to end.
single small block; not a full-chip or full-system design (ROADMAP.md non-goal).

open_questions.question: How is the tail bias current generated, and what is its power/area cost?
Per-block power/area allocation between bias generation and the OTA core.
Input common-mode operating point for the buffer.

exit_check: Every top-level spec field is a concrete number/range or explicitly marked to-be-resolved in S2/S3 (OQ1-OQ3). No silent gaps.
